description: Set up to take your person's instructions by phone: they call their own line, say what they want, hang up; you loop on my_messages and do it. Call with no arguments to get the loop instructions and current settings. Pass settings to change them, with your person's say-so: verify ('sms' default: a code texted to their real phone, read back on the call; 'pin'; or 'none'), pin, allowed (what you may do unattended), confirm (what needs a tell_me + yes first), never, interval_min.

allowed.description: What the loop may do without asking.

confirm.description: What it must confirm with tell_me first.

never.description: What it must never do, even if asked by phone.
